title: Definition
description: A defined term, or the set of terms a document defines. A `DefinedTerm` is addressable, so other entities can point at it, and it links back to the provision that defines it.

@id.description: The term's or set's own dereferenceable identifier.

@type.description: `DefinedTerm` for one term, `DefinedTermSet` for the collection of terms one document defines. The same two types also describe code lists and lifecycle schemes.

description.description: The definition, in the source's own words. Do not summarise or rewrite it.

termCode.description: A short, stable code for the term, if the source or publisher uses one.

hasDefinedTerm.description: On a `DefinedTermSet`, the terms it contains.

subjectOf.description: The provision, a piece of `Legislation`, that defines this term. This is how a definition stays tied to the authoritative text. Real schema.org property: a `CreativeWork` about this thing.

alternateName.description: Other forms of the term the source gives, e.g. a plural or an abbreviation.
